raw_text: Eastern Mirror Nagaland reports that tribal organizations have called a total shutdown across multiple districts amid fears of NSCN-IM ceasefire collapse. The shutdown, coordinated through encrypted social media channels, has disrupted road transport and commercial activity. Assam Rifles and state police have been deployed at key locations in Kohima and Dimapur.
clean_text: Tribal organizations called total shutdown across Nagaland districts amid NSCN-IM ceasefire fears. Road transport and commerce disrupted. Assam Rifles deployed in Kohima and Dimapur.
